verdict.rationale: Rive documents official open-source runtime libraries for loading and controlling animations in apps, games, and websites, with the same exported file usable across web, mobile, and game-engine runtimes. The web runtime has concrete API docs for file caching and data binding (autoBind, bindViewModelInstance), and the rive-runtime GitHub repo shows a C++ core with GPU backends. Community comments corroborate the MIT-licensed runtime and Unreal Engine integration. Missing for 10: per-platform SDK documentation beyond web (mobile, game engines and their languages are only asserted generically), and a community note that the open-sourced piece is a renderer subset that depends on the proprietary Editor for content.
